name: A scorched smell in the service bay
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with the mains taken (FS47FreeformSession::SkyCutBegin): the standby generator rides it, and the mains come back. The mains' return costs the control room two ceiling tubes for good (tube beat, saved; the working light stays).

beats.text: The whole place smells like a struck match.

At {clock} the mains sagged and went with no storm and no fault on the feeder. Afterward the transfer panel smelled scorched, like a struck match. Two of the ceiling tubes in the control room never struck again.
Two of the tubes in here never came back.
